description: Adjust a money amount for UK inflation. Mode 'cpi' uses the ONS monthly CPI index (2015 = 100) between two months from January 1988 to August 2026 and returns the adjusted value, total change and average annual rate. Mode 'custom' compounds a chosen annual rate over a number of years. Amounts in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/inflation-calculator/

mode.description: 'cpi' uses the ONS CPI index between two months; 'custom' uses your own rate

ratePercent.description: Custom mode: annual inflation rate as a percentage (-50 to 100)

toMonth.description: CPI mode: ending month (1 to 12, default is the latest month)

toYear.description: CPI mode: ending year (default is the latest year)

years.description: Custom mode: number of years (0 to 200)

name: hopi_inflation_calculator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: UK inflation calculator
